label: Supergates and balanced trees
subgoals: Collect a supergate's leaves through single-fanout uncomplemented ANDs
Rebuild the multi-input AND as a binary tree
Compute the balanced depth as the ceiling of log base 2 of the leaf count

label: Balancing with arrival levels
subgoals: Sort the supergate's inputs by arrival level
Combine the two lowest-level inputs into a node at max plus one
Repeat until one node remains and read its level

label: Depth reduction and its costs
subgoals: Compute the chain's output level input by input
Compute the balanced output level by greedy pairing
Subtract to find the depth reduction
